info.name: Livestock ERP Financial Depreciation API
info.description: Separate Postman collection for the single-entry depreciation workflow. This module follows the ordered cashbook-deduction behavior: an active depreciation record generates monthly schedule lines, and each posted line creates one Cashbook Out movement until the posted total equals the asset price. This is not formal non-cash accounting depreciation. Requires an active cashbook and an active cash-out category. Before reversing posted depreciation lines, configure the cash-out category's active opposite-direction reversal category using the Cash Ledger Categories API. All endpoints use /api/v1.
